story: A high liver test a year ago, linked to a re-screening question

messages.text: Screening labs back for 1001-106: ALT 140 U/L (ULN 40), AST normal. PI aware, she was not enrolled.
1001-106 is re-screening. Her new ALT is 90 U/L (ULN 40). Is she eligible on liver tests, and how does this compare with her last screening?
